metadata.banner: HARNESS CHECK. FakeModelClient generated these answers and embeddings. Nothing here measures a model; do not report any number from this file.
metadata.fixture_banner: FIXTURE-BASED, NOT A LAB RUN. The engagement is tests/fixtures/observations/ (8 of 10 lab hosts synthetic), and the golden set is generated from that same engagement by evals/scripts/build_assistant_golden.py.
metadata.faithfulness_note: Faithfulness is an entity-level proxy (deterministic grounding check on CVE ids, IPs, ports and citation ids), not RAGAS LLM-judged claim faithfulness.

metric_definitions.faithfulness_answered: Share of answered (non-refused) items whose grounding check has no unsupported entity and no invalid citation. Entity-level proxy, not RAGAS.
metric_definitions.faithfulness_all: Same check over all items; refusals count as faithful, so this is inflated by refusals.
metric_definitions.claim_entity_precision: Answered items: sum(checked - unsupported) / sum(checked) grounding entities.
metric_definitions.context_precision: Items with required_refs: mean |retrieved ∩ required| / |retrieved| by doc id (plain set overlap, not rank-weighted).
metric_definitions.citation_accuracy: Citations in answered items: correct when the cited id was retrieved and supplied (not invalid) AND it is a required_ref or its text contains a must_mention entity or alias. Micro-averaged over citations.
metric_definitions.answer_correctness_proxy: Non-refusal items: mean share of must_mention entities (or aliases) the answer contains, whole-token, case-insensitive.
metric_definitions.refusal_accuracy: expect_refusal items: share the assistant refused.
metric_definitions.false_refusal_rate: Items not expecting refusal: share the assistant refused.
metric_definitions.answer_relevancy_embedding: Answered items: mean cosine(embed(question), embed(answer)) with the retrieval embed model. Not RAGAS answer relevancy.
metric_definitions.uncited_answer_rate: Answered items whose answer carries no citation at all.
